label: Hidden gem weight
definition: Relevance is lowered by this times the song's popularity percentile / 100, so a much-streamed song needs a closer match to be picked.

label: Variety lambda
definition: MMR: each pick maximizes lambda x relevance - (1 - lambda) x its similarity to songs already picked (audio closeness, or 1 for the same first release). 1 = relevance only.
